summary: Iteration 2 (v2 rework) full-stack test. Backend: new pytest suite test_v2_api.py (21 tests) covering config/permissions, bacheca CRUD/tags/search/reactions/replies/inbox/unread, owner lifecycle (edit->pending, complete toggle, delete, reject reason, Passaggi past-date expiry), reports hide/block/ignore + blocked user 403, poll (hidden pct, 409 double vote, close), struct categories/sections (create, submit with new kind, reorder, hide, delete 409 without move_to), config PUT (home title, alert bar, threshold -> display_count, 422 out-of-range), banners (section:case, views/clicks, inactive hidden), users (promote/demote, reset password, change password/email), audit, backup (no password_hash) + restore (admin and user logins still work). 20/21 pass. Frontend (390x844): Home blocks, poll vote -> percentages, Bacheca tiles, Case section with tag filter + partner badge + sponsor banners, guest + / reply -> 'Accedi per continuare', registration, Passaggio published immediately, Spotted pending, 2nd user reply ('Ci sto!' label), reaction, unread badge on Profilo nav, inbox message, mark Completato/Riattiva hides/shows post, admin login -> 16 tabs for superadmin / 7 tabs for promoted admin, reject with reason via prompt, report via UI + ignore in Segnalazioni, banner create -> visible on /bacheca/case, Home title edit -> visible on Explore, section create + field add -> visible in Bacheca and + picker, Statistiche. All passed. All test data cleaned; Home title restored to 'Cosa fare a'/'Potenza', threshold 20, only 'Supreme House Immobiliare' banner remains, admin password untouched.

minor.issue: If body.fields contains a field without 'key' (only label), it is stored as-is (key auto-generation exists only in PUT). Subsequent POST /api/board/{slug}/posts crashes with 500 KeyError: 'key' in clean_post. UI currently creates with name only so not reachable from UI, but API is fragile. Fix: apply the same key slugify in struct_create (and use f.get('key') defensively).
Deleting a user leaves their posts/items public (orphan owner_user); /me/delete removes posts but admin delete does not. Consider deleting or reassigning user content and replies.

Voter key is u:<id> when logged in and d:<device> as guest, so the same person can vote once as guest and again after logging in (seen in UI: poll shows options again after login). Spec: one vote per device/account - consider checking both device and user.
Admin edit does not recompute expires_at (e.g. changing Passaggi date keeps old expiry), unlike owner edit.
Non-numeric trend.threshold -> int() ValueError -> 500 instead of 422.
allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True reflects any Origin (https://evil.com) with credentials=true. Low risk since auth is Bearer/localStorage (no cookies), but set explicit origins.
Does not update existing admin password if ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes (only role/blocked) - playbook item 5.

ui_bugs.issue: When a banner has no image, the 'SPONSORIZZATO' badge overlaps the banner title text (title unreadable) on /bacheca/case.

integration_issues.issue: After login the app lands on /profilo with Messaggi tab default, which immediately calls /me/inbox/read, so the user never sees the unread badge on login (badge works correctly when logged in on other pages).

issues: home-title renders empty briefly while /api/config loads (no skeleton)
